pages.text: $(thing)Curios is optional.$() Tobacconist works without it. If Curios is installed, the mod adds a Mouth slot for smoking items and an Eyes slot for the Spectacles.

Put a cigarette, cigar, or packed pipe in the Curios $(thing)Mouth$() slot and press the Tobacconist keybind $(item)Take a Puff (Mouth Slot)$(). Its default key is $(item)H$(). The server enforces a short 8-tick cooldown against packet/key spam.
pages.title: Mouth Smoking

pages.text: A partially smoked item in the Mouth slot can emit occasional ambient smoke. If the H key does nothing, check that Curios is installed, a supported smokable item is actually in the Mouth slot, and the item still has puffs remaining.
pages.title: Ambient Smoke

pages.text: Without Curios, simply keep using the normal right-click smoking controls. Spectacles also continue to work without Curios by using the vanilla head slot.
pages.title: Without Curios
